versions.changelog: v1.1.0: mandatory feed navigation before every profile (anti-detection), pre-flight checklist (data file + browser setup confirmation), fixed tier order (Direct URL → Google → LinkedIn search), raised session cap to 20-25 requests, both Chrome Relay and openclaw isolated browser supported.

Initial release: bulk LinkedIn connection requests with anti-detection (feed-first navigation), pre-flight checklist, three-tier profile discovery (Direct URL → Google → LinkedIn search), Chrome relay + openclaw browser support, incremental CSV/TSV progress tracking.
